capabilities: Run agent CLIs such as Claude Code on a remote Linux server or locally on desktop
Resume agent sessions across devices with async turn recovery
Chat directly with LLM providers through their APIs without a server
Export phase-gated plans to Markdown notes and Canvas files
Operate a remote PTY terminal over private overlay networks
extras: Free and open source under the MIT license; API usage is billed to the user's own provider accounts; the README explicitly says it is not for users who only want Claude chat on their phone without Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run AI coding agents against a vault from a separate host or to continue an agent session across desktop and mobile devices.

relations.evidence: Claude Code (claude, tested versions 0.2.29–0.2.32) is the primary supported agent CLI.
Model APIs provided by Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, and Ollama.
xterm.js by SourceLair and Christopher Jeffrey (MIT)

requires.name: Linux host running darjeeling-server with Claude Code CLI (remote mode)

summary: Self-hosted AI agent client that runs Claude Code and other agent CLIs on a Linux server and lets you resume the same sessions on desktop or phone.
